summary: Alcorn County, MS lookout: a 100-ft Aermotor tower erected in 1949 and dismantled in 1998; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Dismantled and removed from the site in 1998.

events.note: 100-foot Aermotor tower with 7 x 7 cab erected
Tower dismantled and removed from the site

evidence.quote: 1949: A 100-foot Aermotor tower with 7 x 7 cab was erected.

evidence.supports: Aermotor made galvanized steel towers; 7 x 7 model with 7-by-7-foot steel cab
evidence.quote: The company also manufactured galvanized steel fire lookout towers under the "Aermotor Corporation" name, including a "7 x 7" model which supported a 7-by-7-foot (2.1 m × 2.1 m) steel cab

notes_for_editor: Built (1949) and removed (1998) dates rest on one list, with no second source for this tower. The record's material 'steel' comes from the Aermotor design, not from a source about this tower. Wikipedia is used for design context only. No source describes the site today, so the story says so. Record height 30.5 m matches the 100-foot figure.
